summary.text: Liz Hakola is the Working Class Party nominee for Michigan's 1st District, advancing from the party's convention on June 6, 2026. She appeared on the district's general-election ballot in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Hakola as a general-election candidate for Michigan's 1st District in 2022 and 2024. In 2024 she ran on the Working Class Party line and received 1.8% of the vote (8,497 votes).
